description: Apple has unveiled macOS 27 Golden Gate at WWDC 2026 alongside its latest operating systems for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Vision Pro. The update introduces new Apple Intelligence features, Siri enhancements, design refinements, and performance improvements. It also adds more control over the Liquid Glass interface introduced with macOS Tahoe. macOS 27 is the first major macOS release to drop support for Intel-based Macs, marking another step in Apple's transition to Apple silicon-powered hardware and software.
title: WWDC 2026: Apple Launches macOS 27 Golden Gate With Major Siri Redesign and New AI Tools

description: Apple revealed iOS 27 at WWDC 2026 in Cupertino. The update brings a streamlined interface, improving last year’s Liquid Glass design. Siri has been redesigned and works as a separate app with access to past chats. Apps open up to 30 percent faster. A developer preview is coming, with release expected around September.
title: Apple Unveils iOS 27 at WWDC 2026: Revamped Siri AI App, Faster Performance and Liquid Glass Upgrades

description: Apple unveiled Siri AI and a revamped Apple Intelligence platform at WWDC 2026 alongside iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, and visionOS 27. Siri AI can access information across apps, perform actions, respond to on-screen content, and support more advanced requests. Apple also introduced a dedicated Siri app, a new Search or Ask interface, expanded Visual Intelligence capabilities, and new developer tools. Additional AI-powered features are coming to Safari, Photos, Messages, Mail, and other Apple apps.
title: WWDC 2026: Apple Unveils Siri AI With Major Apple Intelligence Upgrades

description: The Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C) of the Union Ministry of Home Affairs has launched the Mobile Restoration Module (MRM) as part of the National Cybercrime Reporting Portal (NCRP), which is aimed at helping cybercrime victims raise refund requests from the comfort of their homes. The MRM is only capable of processing refunds in case the victim reported the cybercrime immediately after the incident via the 1930 helpline or the NCRP portal, and the money has since been frozen in the scammer’s bank account, making these two the only eligibility criteria for the same.
title: Mobile Restoration Module Explained: What It Is, How Cybercrime Victims Can Request a Refund via the Portal

description: OpenAI has announced a new security feature for ChatGPT to safeguard users and organisations from prompt injection attacks. title: ChatGPT Gets Lockdown Mode to Protect Users From Prompt Injection Attacks, Reduce Data Theft Risks
